stories.title: Saudi Arabia offers rewards of up to SR10 million for reporting unknown endowments

en.title: Saudi Arabia offers rewards of up to SR10 million for reporting unknown endowments
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Endowments established a reward program for reporting unknown endowments, offering up to SR10 million or five percent of the endowment's value, whichever is lower. The initiative aims to identify and revive dormant endowments while preserving donor intentions.

stories.title: Rybakina Withdraws from Wuhan with Injury after China Open Exit

en.title: Rybakina Withdraws from Wuhan with Injury after China Open Exit
en.summary: Tennis player Rybakina has withdrawn from the Wuhan tournament following her exit from the China Open due to an injury.

stories.title: KAUST, Oxford Develop Electronic Sensor to Detect Parkinson’s Markers in Blood

en.title: KAUST, Oxford Develop Electronic Sensor to Detect Parkinson's Markers in Blood
en.summary: KAUST and Oxford University have jointly developed an electronic sensor capable of detecting markers associated with Parkinson's disease in blood samples.

stories.title: King Salman Invites Qatar’s Emir to Participate in Second GCC-EU Summit

en.title: King Salman Invites Qatar's Emir to Participate in Second GCC-EU Summit
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's King Salman has invited Qatar's Emir to attend the second GCC-EU Summit.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Provides $59.7 Million to Support Yemen's Budget, Salaries

en.title: Saudi Arabia Provides $59.7 Million to Support Yemen's Budget, Salaries
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has provided 59.7 million dollars in financial assistance to support Yemen's government budget and salary payments.

stories.title: EU weighs cost of open trade policy with China

en.title: EU weighs cost of open trade policy with China
en.summary: The European Union is reassessing its trade relationship with China amid concerns about its trade deficit, with senior EU officials increasingly focused on finding consensus among member states on a potential policy shift.

stories.title: King Salman invites Qatar emir to GCC-EU Summit to be held in October

en.title: King Salman invites Qatar emir to GCC-EU Summit to be held in October
en.summary: Saudi King Salman has invited Qatar's Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al-Thani to attend a GCC-EU Summit scheduled for October 24 in the Kingdom, with discussions focusing on strengthening bilateral relations.

stories.title: Al-Alimi Announces Start of Full-Scale Military Campaign Against Houthis

en.title: Al-Alimi Announces Start of Full-Scale Military Campaign Against Houthis
en.summary: Al-Alimi has announced the commencement of a comprehensive military campaign targeting the Houthis.

stories.title: KAUST develops sensor for potential early detection of Parkinson’s disease

en.title: KAUST develops sensor for potential early detection of Parkinson's disease
en.summary: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology researchers have created an electronic sensor that detects molecular signatures of Parkinson's disease in blood samples. The technology, developed with Oxford University collaboration, can identify three forms of alpha-synuclein protein linked to the disease before symptoms appear.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia provides SR224 million in new budget support to Yemen

en.title: Saudi Arabia provides SR224 million in new budget support to Yemen
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has allocated over 224 million Saudi riyals in financial assistance to Yemen through its development program to support government operations, salary payments, and economic development. The funding aims to strengthen purchasing power and stimulate commercial activity.

stories.title: OPEC+ Agrees to Keep November Oil Output Targets Steady

en.title: OPEC+ Agrees to Keep November Oil Output Targets Steady
en.summary: OPEC+ member countries agreed to maintain their oil production levels for November without changes.

stories.title: OPEC+ agree to keep oil output level unchanged for November

en.title: OPEC+ agree to keep oil output level unchanged for November
en.summary: OPEC+ member nations decided to maintain unchanged oil production levels for November during a virtual meeting reviewing global market conditions and economic outlook.

stories.title: ‎Foreign institutions net sellers of SAR 751.6M shares

en.title: Foreign institutions net sellers of SAR 751.6M shares
en.summary: Foreign institutions sold a net SAR 751.6 million worth of TASI stocks during the week ended October 1. Saudi institutional investors, led by corporates, were also net sellers of shares worth SAR 464.7 million.

stories.title: ‎AYYAN CEO resigns; Muhammed Al-Nuwaiser takes helm

en.title: AYYAN CEO resigns; Muhammed Al-Nuwaiser takes helm
en.summary: AYYAN Investment Co.'s CEO Raed Al-Naeem resigned on October 4 for personal reasons. Muhammed Al-Nuwaiser, who has over 20 years of financial and banking experience, was appointed as his successor.

stories.title: ‎2P renews SAR 120M credit facilities with NBK

en.title: 2P renews SAR 120M credit facilities with NBK
en.summary: Perfect Presentation for Commercial Services Co. renewed SAR 120 million in Shariah-compliant credit facilities with National Bank of Kuwait on October 4, valid through October 4, 2027. The facility will support new project contracts and letter of credit issuances.

stories.title: ‎Tadawul approves SNB Capital as market maker for Almarai, Al Rajhi Bank, SABIC

en.title: Tadawul approves SNB Capital as market maker for Almarai, Al Rajhi Bank, SABIC
en.summary: Saudi Exchange approved SNB Capital to conduct market-making activities for Almarai, Al Rajhi Bank, and SABIC effective October 5, 2026, with an 80% minimum order presence requirement and maximum spread of 0.65%.

en.title: CMA: Leadership directs focus on fairness
en.summary: The Capital Market Authority's chairman stated that directives from Saudi leadership emphasize ensuring market fairness and addressing challenges. The CMA aims to strengthen market confidence through reforms necessitated by recent structural developments.
